title: Pure Mist Ice Mint 10ml E-Liquid
description: Pure Mist Ice Mint combines the fresh, crisp taste of Mint with a brisk, icy Menthol finish. This revitalising e-liquid delivers a smooth and refreshing vape, perfect for vapers seeking a clean and cooling flavour profile. The Pure Mist High-PG collection offers a variety of VG/PG ratios to cater to different preferences. The 3mg nicotine strength features a 50VG/50PG blend for balanced vapour and flavour production, while the 0mg, 6mg, 12mg, and 18mg strengths use a high-PG 30VG/70PG ratio for a more intense flavour with discreet vapour. Designed for use with Mouth-to-Lung (MTL) devices, Pure Mist Gold provides a flavour-packed option for discerning adult vapers. Made in the UK with premium ingredients, this e-liquid delivers consistent quality and satisfaction.
